_note: List of drugs prohibited for manufacture and sale through gazette notifications under section 26A of the Drugs & Cosmetics Act 1940, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. Extracted by OCR from the official CDSCO PDF (see scripts/parse_cdsco_banned_pdf.py). 420 of the document's 444 rows were read; ingredient names were repaired against the medicine catalogue's molecule vocabulary where the scan was damaged, and each entry keeps its raw text alongside the parsed ingredients. Only 'single' and 'combination' entries are matched automatically -- 'class_rule' entries ('corticosteroids with any other drug for internal use') need drug-class data we hold for only the curated set, and guessing at them would produce false alarms. Re-verify against https://cdsco.gov.in before any clinical or production use.
_source: CDSCO / Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, section 26A list

_caveats.stayed_madras_hc: This prohibition is currently stayed by the Madras High Court, so the medicine may still be legally on sale while the case is decided.
_caveats.revoked_with_conditions: This prohibition was revoked with conditions (G.S.R. 367, 13.04.2017): the drug is permitted for cancer pain only, at no more than 300 mg per day.
_caveats.quashed_delhi_hc_under_appeal: The notification behind this entry was quashed by the Delhi High Court on 01.12.2016 and is under appeal before the Supreme Court, so its legal status is unsettled.

_caveat_note: The source document carries three footnotes marking entries that are stayed by the Madras High Court, revoked with conditions, or quashed by the Delhi High Court and under Supreme Court appeal. The footnote markers are asterisks printed beside the drug name and the scan does not reproduce them reliably, so they could NOT be attributed to individual entries. Any warning raised from this list must therefore say that the legal status of some entries is unsettled, rather than asserting a live ban.
